Unofficial port of https://github.com/tannerkrewson/spyfall (MIT).

Upstream is a Next.js + Express + Socket.IO app: server.js boots Node,
server/Game.js is the room (deals the spy, the location, the roles, and
the timer), and the browser is a React client of that socket. None of
that ships here. The GifOS invite is the room. The Node process, the
socket, and every access code stay behind.

What was kept: the Spyfall 1 location pack and the English names/roles
from locales/en.i18n.json, the deal (one spy, everyone else a role at
the same place, someone asks first), the eight-minute timer, and the
in-round location list.

What was rewritten: the UI as classic scripts (GifOS drops type=module),
and the wire. Each player stores their own card in a private collection
and publishes only their location vote on their own row.
